blocks.text: Vivienne Marcheline, daughter of former couple Angelina Jolie and Brad Pitt, has officially dropped the Hollywood actor’s surname after a Los Angeles, California judge granted her petition. The 18-year-old celebrity was granted legal approval to change her name from Vivienne Marcheline Jolie-Pitt to Vivienne Marcheline Jolie following a petition hearing held on Monday, Nov. 2. The judge’s approval came about three months after Vivienne filed the petition in July, shortly after marking her 18th birthday.
